messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @sam (oncall) — anomaly detected: contbatch-serving-usw2 p99 jumped to 2.4s, streaming stalls observed, SLO=1.2s. Auto-alert triggered at 1770012478.

sam: oncall here, joining. Mira/Jon, can you dump the contbatch scheduler stats and recent deploys?

mira: pulling scheduler metrics now. p95 ~300ms, p99 ~2400ms. spike correlated with increase in streaming enqueue latency and packer backlog. no recent model deploys in last 12h. there was a config push to packer heuristic yesterday (rollout 50%).

jon: checking packer logs. seeing many batches with a single "long" sequence (len>900) paired with several <64 tokens. padding amplification factor ~7x. long requests are not preempting the batch.

lina: ops note: some customers report slow streaming chunks and stalled WS connections (clients retrying). no 5xxs, just slow. are we hitting KV thrash/rebuilds?

mira: KV churn spike at 1770012405 — eviction storms on some nodes. redis-metrics show increased miss rate. long sequences caused heavier KV loads.

sam: immediate mitigation options (ranked): A) enable aggressive seq-preempt to isolate long seqs B) limit streaming pack size to 6 C) shift streaming traffic to a dedicated non-packed pool (usw2-stream-isolate) D) enable short-request-priority scheduler.

jon: A+B low-risk and quick. C depends on capacity — can do partial shift. D is more invasive.

mira: I'll flip preempt and reduce pack size. prepping commands.

jon: commands:
```
# reduce pack size
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/api/v1/runtime -d '{"path":"/contbatch/stream/max_pack","value":6}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" 

# enable preempt
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/api/v1/runtime -d '{"path":"/contbatch/stream/preempt_long_seq","value":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP"
```

mira: applied both at 1770012518. ops-agent: config apply id cfg-1770012518 :white_check_mark:

ops-rotations-bot: Note: auto-notify on-call replacement (sam -> lina) at 1770012560. Handoff pending.

sam: metrics now: p99 dropping to 1.5s within one minute. p95 unchanged. good sign. however a small subset of nodes still showing >2s — likely those with heavy KV miss rates.

lina: I'm starting a targeted route split for the heaviest tenants to usw2-stream-isolate at 10% increments. starting 10% now.

jon: routing split 10% applied at 1770012535. will watch.

mira: pv logs show GC spike on nodes a,b at 1770012406. restarting cache worker on those nodes might help. proposing a rolling soft-restart of kv-cache-worker on affected hosts.

sam: prefer config toggles first, then restarts if needed. keep restarts as fallback.

lina: 10% -> 30% -> 60% over 6 minutes. at 1770012550 we are at 30% reroute. p99 on primary pool now 1.25s, global p99 ~1.3s.

lina: customer comms: sent interim note to SRE contacts for affected tenants. advising retries/backoff guidance.

jon: root cause hypothesis: packer heuristic change (PR #4679) increased cross-length co-packing to boost throughput. In mixed streaming workloads when KV miss rate rises, long seqs become stragglers and inflate p99.

mira: evidence: compare job traces pre/post PR: co-pack rate increased 42%, tail latency for long sequences increased 3x on co-packed batches.

sam: next actions while monitoring:
- keep preempt + max_pack=6 for 90 minutes
- do not revert yet; collect traces and flamegraphs (owner: jon)
- run synthetic replay with 25% long, 75% short seqs and KV miss toggled (owner: mira)
- prepare rollback playbook for PR #4679 if mitigations insufficient (owner: sam)

jon: creating temporary dashboard with per-node pack stats, KV miss, and p99. link: https://grafana.internal/d/contbatch/mixedseq-tail

ops-rotations-bot: @lina, you are now primary oncall for this incident. Please ack and monitor.

lina: ack — monitoring. If p99 > 1.4s for more than 5m, escalate to infra and initiate cache worker restart on nodes a,b.

mira: synthetic test setup scheduled in 30m. I'll include KV miss simulation (fail open) to reproduce worst-case.

sam: handoff note for postmortem: include config rollout timeline, packer PR diff, KV GC windows, mitigation toggles and decision log. owner: sam -> postmortem to be filed in #incidents and linked to this thread.

lina: current p99 1.22s, steady for 3 minutes. keeping mitigations. I will ramp down reroute in 30m if stable.

jon: added canary revert for PR #4679 in perf branch; will run A/B test once we have a controlled window.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to 'mitigated' by lina at 1770012568. Auto-close postponed until postmortem uploaded.

lina: closing handoff: leaving preempt + max_pack=6 for 90m, monitoring dashboard pinned. final note: prioritize introducing gating for packer rollouts based on mixed-seq ratio and KV hit thresholds.

(END thread)
